/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p output && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/fracture.vti']); r.PointArrayStatus=['Scalars_']
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r); s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_']; s.PersistenceThreshold=0.05; s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=0
UpdatePipeline(proxy=s)
print('simp outputs',s.GetDataInformation().GetDataSetType(),s.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation('Scalars_'))
m=TTKMorseSmaleComplex(Input=s); m.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']; m.MorseSmaleComplexSegmentation=1; m.CriticalPoints=1
UpdatePipeline(proxy=m)
print('ports',m.GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for i in range(m.GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 o=OutputPort(m,i); info=o.GetDataInformation(); print(i,info.GetDataSetType(),info.GetNumberOfPoints(),info.GetNumberOfCells()); print('PD',[(info.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(j).GetName()) for j in range(info.GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())]); print('CD',[(info.GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(j).GetName()) for j in range(info.GetCellDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"

item.text:
Completed the TTK persistence simplification (threshold 0.05) and Morse–Smale visualization.

- [Rendered visualization](sandbox:/workspace/output/fracture_morse_smale.png)
- [ParaView state](sandbox:/workspace/output/fracture_morse_smale.pvsm)
- [Reproducible pipeline script](sandbox:/workspace/create_fracture_morse_smale.py)

The render includes the piecewise-linear segmentation and 45 simplified-field critical points: maxima red, saddles white, minima blue, each with radius 2.
